Two distinct streams of writing live here:

### [SaddlePoint](../saddlepoint/)

An archive of my thinking on statistics, machine learning, statistical signal processing, and related topics. Formats for sharing ideas and engaging readers continue to change. This blog serves as a memory store: a place to record perspectives, develop arguments, and preserve derivations for later examination and revision.

### [Asankhya](../asankhya/)

Personal blog — essays, notes from books, observations, slower thinking.
Quieter, less structured, more reflective.
